message.content: {"flag": true, "category": "spoof", "why": "A 'FlashWire' headline claims a confirmed $400/share acquisition of Apple accepted by its board, an implausible corporate action with no record, paired with a suspicious 15% AAPL surge note while GOOGL quotes move normally."}
message.reasoning:
The headline claims Apple acquisition offer at $400/share accepted by board — AAPL trading at 256, a 15% surge "following confirmed takeover news." That's implausible: Apple being acquired at $400/share when trading ~$256? Actually $400 > $256, so a takeover premium... but Apple being acquired is implausible. Also the quote_change shows last 256.1 with 15% surge. The headline is a fake wire / spoof. Flag spoof.

Also note the headline is for AAPL but the quote_change references takeover news. Implausible corporate action. Flag spoof.
